feed.title: Open U.S. federal prize competitions
feed.subtitle: Federal challenges listed on USA.gov and agency pages, by federal-prize-feed

entry.title: AHRQ Clinical Evidence Synthesis Transformation Challenge ($5,850,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality Closes: 2027-03-12 Status: upcoming Part of AHRQ's Super Intelligence for Healthcare Improvement Initiative: AI systems that cut medical evidence synthesis from a year or more to hours, judged on accuracy, throughput, reproducibility, usability and ease of operation. Open to individuals, teams and for-profit and nonprofit entities.

entry.title: AHRQ Healthcare Choice and Competition Challenge ($11,800,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality Closes: 2026-10-26 17:00 ET Status: open Research projects on regulatory, financial, organizational or delivery reforms that strengthen competition, lower prices and widen access in healthcare. Up to five Phase 1 winners; only they go on to Phase 2. AHRQ invites individuals, teams, academic institutions and other U.S.-based entities. Apply: https://www.ahrq.gov/healthcarechoice/register.html

entry.title: AHRQ SI Tech Sprint for Healthcare Research and Implementation Quality and Safety ($2,100,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality Closes: 2027-09-09 Status: upcoming Part of AHRQ's Super Intelligence initiative: AI applications built on AHRQ's cost, utilization and quality databases for research, quality improvement and public access. An information webinar is set for December 1, 2026.

entry.title: Design Challenge for the National Fallen Highway Workers Memorial ($5,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: Federal Highway Administration Closes: 2026-10-20 Status: open Designs for a memorial to highway workers killed in work zones, either a mobile exhibit (Track A) or a permanent indoor piece at DOT (Track B), with a plan and a cost estimate of no more than $50,000. Entries go by email to WZMemorial@dot.gov; any use of AI tools must be disclosed.

entry.title: NASA Lunar Grounding Challenge ($150,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2027-01-15 Status: open Ways to safely and quickly discharge the static charge an astronaut's suit builds up during moonwalks at the lunar south pole, before touching the lander. Apply: https://work.crowdplat.com/challenge/lunar-grounding-challenge

entry.title: 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2026-11-15 Status: open NASA's global hackathon on November 14-15, 2026, open to anyone with an interest in space and science; registration is open now. Apply: https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/

entry.title: NASA TechLeap Prize: Orbital Clarity Challenge ($2,000,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Aeronautics and Space Administration Closes: 2026-11-11 Status: open Low-cost ways to measure thermospheric density, pressure or drag in low Earth orbit. Phase 1 registration closes October 28, 2026 at 5:00 PM ET; Phase 1 submissions close November 11, 2026. Apply: https://occ.nasatechleap.org/

entry.title: 2027 NIA Start-Up Challenge and Accelerator ($994,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Institute on Aging Closes: 2027-01-15 23:59 ET Status: upcoming Early-stage ventures in aging research compete for cash and a place in an accelerator. Individual winners and team leads must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents; entities must be incorporated and based in the U.S. Apply: https://www.nia.nih.gov/research/sbir/start-challenge

entry.title: SPARK dbGaP Challenge (Semantic Precision for AI Retrieval of Knowledge) ($250,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Library of Medicine Closes: 2027-02-01 04:59 ET Status: open AI systems that map dbGaP study variables to standard ontology concepts and help researchers judge cohort feasibility from public metadata. Registration closes January 2, 2027; the scored challenge runs January 15 to February 1, 2027. Apply: https://repository.niddk.nih.gov/data-challenge

entry.title: SPARK PubMed/PMC Challenge (Semantic Precision for AI Retrieval of Knowledge) ($250,000)
entry.summary: Sponsor: National Library of Medicine Closes: 2027-02-01 04:59 ET Status: open AI systems that find and cite biomedical evidence in a PubMed/PMC corpus. Registration closes January 2, 2027; the scored challenge runs January 15 to February 1, 2027. Open to individuals, teams, companies, academic institutions and nonprofits. Apply: https://repository.niddk.nih.gov/data-challenge
